description: The vertx entry on Oracle GraalVM 25 in JIT mode: the same code and JVM flags, run on HotSpot with the Graal compiler (libgraal, the distribution default) in place of C2. Eclipse Vert.x 5 with vertx-web on Netty's epoll transport, one Vert.x instance with its own SO_REUSEPORT listener per core. Routing and query/path params through the Router API, JsonObject serialization, gzip through the server compression option, TLS through BoringSSL (netty-tcnative).
